episodes.154940: Early morning thunderstorms caused a lightning strike which resulted in significant damage to a home in Houston county.
episodes.154941: Early morning thunderstorms caused a lightning strike which resulted in damage to a home in Calhoun county.  In addition, there was isolated minor flooding reported in Bay county due to heavy rainfall.
episodes.154954: Several morning storms developed in the vicinity of a warm front lifting northward into south Georgia. Upper level shear increased in the hail growth zone in the morning ahead of an approaching upper level short wave trough, which resulted in several storms that produced hail 0.25-0.88 inches.
episodes.155269: A front heading quickly east brought downpours to windward Big Island before exiting the Aloha State.  The precipitation caused small stream and drainage ditch flooding, and ponding on roadways.  No significant injuries or property damage were reported.
episodes.156034: Strong thunderstorms moved across during the early morning hours. One of the storms produced large hail.

events.narrative: The Lucy Fire Department Facebook page reported a residential structure fire due to lightning with significant damage.
Hail fell for about 1.5 minutes and covered about 50-75% of the ground.
The Nettle Ridge Fire Department Facebook page reported a structure fire due to lightning on NW County Road 375 North.  Damage cost was estimated.
Nickel size hail and about 1.5 inches of rainfall was reported.
Jens Ave flooded between Baldwin Road and SR 390.
Radar estimated the time of the event.
